description: Ministry of Defence - Notify the Award of Uttama Seva Padakkama to the persons in the Armed Forces - 2014/2015
reasoning: This gazette announces military awards (Uttama Seva Padakkama) to named Sri Lanka Army personnel (officers and other ranks) for their service. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it involves military honors and recognition within the armed forces structure, specifically covering appointments and awards for military personnel.
